summary.text: Jeff Wiley is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 81, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Ascension, Livingston, and St. James parishes. First elected in 2023, Jeff Wiley sits on the Administration of Criminal Justice, Judiciary, and Transportation, Highways and Public Works committees.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Jeff Wiley's occupation as retired sheriff of Ascension Parish (1996 to 2019), with a B.A. from Southwestern Louisiana University (1974).

The House page lists Jeff Wiley's committee assignments as Administration of Criminal Justice, Judiciary, Transportation, Highways and Public Works, House Select Committee on Homeland Security, and Special Committee on Military and Veterans Affairs, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation, Capital Region Legislative Delegation, Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, and Louisiana Rural Caucus.
